[OBJC] EducationViewState3
[OBJC] Why is Alcohol important?
[OBJC] Calories are a unit of energy. We get our energy from food and expend that energy in multiple ways, including exercise. Tracking your daily calorie expenditure can help you manage your weight according to your goals.
[OBJC] In general, the more you exercise, the more calories you burn. These calories are the ones you have the most control over and the primary reason why our caloric needs can vary so much from day to day.
[OBJC] If you consume more calories than you expend you will gain mass (muscle or fat), if you consume fewer calories than you expend you will lose mass, and if you match input to output your weight stays the same.
